how_chosen: Each family's top general model as its provider presents it today, picked from the provider's models endpoint (node bench.mjs models) and its model docs. temperature 0 where the API accepts it, otherwise null (the provider's default); reasoning or thinking is left at the provider's default.

models.name: gpt-6-astra
models.settings: default: the API answers 400 'Only the default (1) value is supported' for temperature 0; default reasoning effort
models.why: OpenAI's models page: "If you're not sure where to start, use GPT-6 Astra, our flagship model". gpt-6.1-sol is the cheaper near-Astra tier.

models.name: claude-opus-5-5
models.settings: default: the API answers 400 '`temperature` is deprecated for this model'; adaptive thinking (always on) at the default effort; max_tokens 8192
models.why: Anthropic's models overview: "If you're unsure which model to use, start with Claude Opus 5.5 for most workloads". Claude Fable 5.2 ($8/$40) is positioned for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work.

models.name: gemini-4-carbon
models.settings: temperature 0 (accepted); thinking at the default level
models.why: Google's pricing page: "Our most capable reasoning model"; the models page: "Our strongest reasoning model". Gemini 4 Argon is the faster, cheaper frontier tier.

price.note: Output includes thinking tokens. $2/$10 through 2026-11-30, $4/$20 from 2026-12-01.

models.name: muse-spark-open
models.family: Meta (Muse; Together AI serves no Llama model serverless any more)
models.why: Meta's largest model on Together AI's serverless API. Llama 4 Maverick and Llama 3.3 70B answer 400 'Unable to access non-serverless model' and need a paid dedicated endpoint.

models.name: deepseek-v4-pro
models.why: DeepSeek's Pro tier on Together AI's serverless API; V4.1 Flash is the newer, smaller tier.
